title: Weekend Wine Down| Leaning Into Liens
description:
Sarah Sharp's weekly wine down is here 🍷

This week, she's venturing into Liens while sipping on sparkling rosé.

But it's not all about the wine.🍷

Sarah highlights something critical with deals: understanding liens.

Liens can derail deals if not addressed early.

She shares stories where buyers and sellers were caught off guard by existing liens.
